purpose: Cover the --mode flag on rcf verify run and rcf build finalise, the deterministic engine output shape (findings/blockedAcs/runStats), the finalise preseed partial-report fallback, and the ADR-4112 deterministic-mode refusal line.
title: Verify-modes CLI + deterministic engine + preseed partial report

testCases.description: run --mode deterministic emits BLOCKED with critique-only blockedAcs on every testable AC
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/cli/run-mode-deterministic.test.js::run --mode deterministic: BLOCKED with critique-only blockedAcs on every AC

testCases.description: finalise refuses promotion on a deterministic PASS with skipped>0, naming the counts line and ADR-4112
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-deterministic-mode.test.js::finalise: deterministic-mode PASS with skipped>0 is REFUSED (never silently promotes)

testCases.description: finalise overwrites the preseed stub with a status: aborted record when verify exits non-zero without writing
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-deterministic-mode.test.js::finalise: verify exits non-zero without writing report -> partial `aborted` record overwrites the preseed stub

testCases.description: verify run --mode and finalise --mode refuse an unknown value with exit 2
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-deterministic-mode.test.js::finalise: --mode unknown value is a usage error (exit 2)
